decided: 2026-11-27, from documentation only, before any CGGA microarray value was read
rule: pre-registration 2.2 item 9(d): as distributed if the source's documentation says the values are log2, otherwise log2(x + 1)

evidence.Zhao et al. 2021, Genomics Proteomics Bi: GeneSpring GX11.0 was applied to calculate probe intensity.
evidence.https://www.cgga.org.cn/about.jsp: Probe intensities were normalized using GeneSpring GX 11.0.
evidence.finding: Neither source, nor the download page, states that the values are log2 (checked 2026-11-27: no 'log2' in either text). The 'otherwise' branch applies.

contingencies_registered_2026-11-27: If any value is below 0, the values are already on a log scale (linear intensities cannot be negative) and are used as distributed; the output records that this applied.
A frozen gene with a missing or non-finite value is dropped for that sample only; genes used per sample are reported.
